changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionRollupPathFilter') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] ( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [AssetVersionRollupPathUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] int NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] int not null, [Operator] varchar(10) not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath] FOREIGN KEY([AssetVersionRollupPathUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_MetricAssetVersionRollupPath] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ON DELETE NO ACTION ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_AssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE NO ACTION ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_FieldType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_AssetVersionRollupPath') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter_AssetVersionRollupPath ON [metrics].AssetVersionRollupPathFilter ( AssetVersionRollupPathUid ASC ) END
